[[Gilded Path]] |sandbox = Yes |rewards_increase = +10% }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Enemies spawn on all paths.|In-Game Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''All Paths''' is a [[Modifiers|modifier]] that makes enemies spawn on each path in equal amounts on maps with multiple paths, with some exceptions. '''All Paths''' appears exclusively in [[Black Spot Exchange]], [[Badlands II]], [[Mason Arch]], [[Winter Stronghold]], [[Enchanted Forest]], [[Musaceae Kingdom]], [[Derelict Outpost]], [[Infernal Abyss]], [[Space City]], [[Retro Zone]], [[Legacy Space City]], [[Hot Spot]] and [[Gilded Path]]; it is active in all matches on those maps. For event maps, it is active in [[Krampus Frosthold]], [[Containment]], [[Pls Donate]] and [[Bathroom Approach]]. ==Effects== When active, '''All Paths''' will make most enemies spawn in equal amounts on each path. There are, however, some exceptions to this: *In [[Krampus Frosthold]], the [[Gatekeeper (Krampus Frosthold)|Gatekeeper]], [[Ripped Elf (Krampus Frosthold)|Ripped Elf]] and [[Krampus (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus]] can only spawn on either of the middle two paths. Which path varies between matches. *Major bosses are not affected by '''All Paths'''; only one major boss may spawn at a time. **This, however, does not apply to every enemy with the [[Boss]] attribute, only certain ones which are mainly final bosses. *The [[Cavalry]] is not duplicated. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''30 September 2022''' -
